hypotheses.reasoning: msg-798041 on partition 10 contains a null byte and fails JSON parsing every time. Because no max-retries is configured, it gets nacked and redelivered without end (attempt 24 and counting). That blocks partition 10, so lag there keeps growing while CPU stays normal. The GC pause at #61 came earlier, was small, and doesn't explain this.
There was a single GC pause. It's unlikely to be the cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-798041 (partition 10, offset 269792) to a dead-letter queue or skip it. Set a max-retries limit with a DLQ on order-consumer. Then find out why the producer wrote a payload containing a null byte.
